name: Tempus AI
verdict_line: Real data-network moat, but priced as software when three-quarters is a reimbursement-gated lab — demanding until the 73%-GM data leg compounds (NRR back above 100%) and GAAP FCF beats dilution.

name: Caris Life Sciences
verdict_line: Profitable precision-onco lab (+79%, 65% GM, +$442m net cash) at a Dx-not-software ~5x EV/sales; good business fairly-to-cheaply priced, but the re-rate hinges on one ASP reset holding.

name: Natera
verdict_line: Category-leading tumor-informed MRD franchise with a rising ~65% GM and a landed cash inflection, but priced full — the ~15x-sales multiple already assumes the uncontracted Signatera ASP climb to $2,000 and durable CMS coverage both hold, and the coverage/evidence moat (~5-8yr) is capped by budget-neutrality repricing risk.

name: Guardant Health
verdict_line: Good business, richly expected: genuine liquid-biopsy franchise with a real coverage moat, priced at a software-annuity multiple its per-test margins and reimbursement-gated screening TAM have not yet earned.

name: Exact Sciences
verdict_line: Good business: real code/coverage screening moat plus rare positive FCF, acquired by Abbott at a full but defensible ~7x-sales expectation — the franchise, not the AI, got paid for.

name: Personalis
verdict_line: Differentiated MRD tech in a capital-hungry, reimbursement-gated per-test archetype, priced rich (~15x EV/sales) as if the coverage-and-margin crossover is already won when the margin line says it has not begun.

name: Veracyte
verdict_line: Good business — GAAP-profitable, self-funding, ~76% GM, coverage-moated core — at a full-to-rich expectation that already banks an MRD re-acceleration the guide does not show.

name: GE HealthCare
verdict_line: Durable #2 imaging OEM with installed-base lock-in, priced as a low-growth industrial at ~12-13x forward P/E; good business at a fair-to-cheap expectation, but the AI moat is refuted.

name: Butterfly Network
verdict_line: Real, hard-to-copy ultrasound-on-chip (a semiconductor moat, not a healthcare-AI one) bolted to an unproven, one-deal-deep Embedded licensing story, priced at ~16x forward EV/sales as if the platform is already built — good technology, rich expectation.

name: Absci
verdict_line: A real, well-funded AI-antibody call option — not a good business yet, priced on an analyst-assumed 35% coin-flip on one POC, with a data-flywheel moat that is refuted and untested by the flagship.

name: Recursion
verdict_line: Capital-hungry pre-revenue own-pipeline book; the data flywheel is the sub-sector's clearest refutation, and ~30x milestone-lumpy sales still capitalizes an unproven flywheel-to-drug link.

name: Schrodinger
verdict_line: Good capital-light software moat (~5-8yr) strapped to a de-risked option-value pipeline, priced full on a re-acceleration the last prints (11% growth, 81%->69% GM) haven't earned; net cash is the floor.

name: CRISPR Therapeutics
verdict_line: Strongest survivor of a hard owned-pipeline gene-editing cohort — approved product, ~$2.0bn cash, correctly liver/blood-concentrated pipeline — but ~$2.7bn EV prices in-vivo Phase-II success and a >$1bn Casgevy peak the readouts have not yet earned; a good balance sheet at a full expectation.

name: Beam Therapeutics
verdict_line: Cohort leader with the best AATD human dataset and funding to mid-2029, at a fair-to-slightly-rich binary-option price; good asset optionality, not yet a good business.

name: Intellia
verdict_line: Cohort's clearest clinical winner (first in-vivo Ph3 win), but priced at a full expectation that has already banked lonvo-z approval and pays up-front for a ramp and ATTR share facing unpriced friction.

name: Prime Medicine
verdict_line: Distressed tail of the editing cohort: pre-revenue, cash into 2027 racing 2027 readouts, priced ~$570m EV as a survival option not a franchise.

name: Generate Biomedicines
verdict_line: Single-asset Phase-3 binary priced with a platform-moat premium the audit refutes; expectation looks full ahead of the SOLAIRIA readout that decides everything.

name: Insilico Medicine
verdict_line: Commoditizing AI drug-discovery platform wrapped around one differentiated binary asset (rentosertib) — real human POC, priced at a rich ~50x-shrinking-sales pipeline-optionality expectation, not a franchise.

name: NVIDIA
verdict_line: Exceptional infra-toll (~75% GM, ~45% FCF margin, CUDA moat) at a fair-to-full expectation; ~30x trailing holds only if margins and capex cycle persist — own as the semis/AI toll, not a healthcare name.

name: Microsoft
verdict_line: Good business at a fair-to-full expectation, but NOT a healthcare-AI expression: Dragon Copilot is a durable infra-toll fragment inside an AI-capex bet, immaterial to the multiple.

name: Alphabet
verdict_line: Durable L0 platform (decade+ moat, 31.6% margins) at a fair ~27x market multiple, mid-transition to capital-hungry as capex doubles to ~$180bn; healthcare-AI content is free optionality, not a thesis.

name: Amazon
verdict_line: Durable L0 compute toll (AWS) at a full expectation; risk has shifted from growth to whether the $200bn AI build earns its cost of capital before depreciation compresses the 37.7% margin — the One Medical/HealthScribe healthcare angle is a strategic wedge, not a value driver.

name: Oracle Health / Cerner
verdict_line: Durable #2 EHR rail with a real L0 switching-cost moat, but a ~9%-revenue, share-losing, margin-dilutive annuity inside a stock priced entirely on AI-cloud — good business at a fair-to-full expectation, not the reason to own or avoid ORCL.

name: Waystar
verdict_line: Profitable, capital-light owner of the payer claims-to-cash rail — good business at a fair-to-slightly-cheap expectation if ~112% NRR holds against Epic envelopment.

name: Doximity
verdict_line: Good business (>90% GM, net-cash, ~49% FCF-conversion, verified-physician audience moat) but mis-archetyped as SaaS when it is ad-cyclical, at a fair expectation that still embeds a re-acceleration the FY27 ~+4% guide does not support.

name: Veeva Systems
verdict_line: Best-in-study durable owned-workflow / data-licensing compounder — GAAP-profitable, net-cash, ~45% non-GAAP margins, >100% cash conversion — now at a full expectation that prices durability over growth as a finite vertical decelerates to ~12%.

name: Isomorphic Labs
verdict_line: Demo-plus frontier drug lab; the only credible moat (owned assets vs risk-bearing pharma) is real but binary and unproven, gated on a ~40% Phase II wall no lab has moved — size for optionality, not conviction.

name: Xaira Therapeutics
verdict_line: Well-capitalized frontier shot on goal, but demo/optionality not durable value capture: data flywheel is the refuted discovery form, own-pipeline moat gated by the ~40% Phase-II wall with zero human data; priced at a thin ~2.7x on capital.

name: Iambic Therapeutics
verdict_line: Demo/optionality: a fast AI discovery platform (~1-year commoditizing moat) wrapped around one early-stage owned HER2 asset gated by an unproven Phase-II efficacy readout.

name: Genesis Therapeutics
verdict_line: FEATURE-PLUS, not yet a durable value-capturer — grade C+ (conditional), confidence MEDIUM: commercially validated platform whose model commoditizes in ~1yr and whose value sits behind the unmoved ~40% Phase-II wall.

name: Retro Biosciences
verdict_line: Demo/optionality pre-clinical longevity bet, not a durable value-capturer — full expectation on the Altman/OpenAI narrative, with the headline AI edge rented from OpenAI and everything gated on the unchanged ~40% Phase-II wall.

name: Chai Discovery
verdict_line: Best-in-class founders and real pharma access on a commoditizing model layer (its own Chai-1 is the proof); demo/feature with relationship optionality, not yet a durable value-capturer, at a rich private mark — Grade C+.

name: EvolutionaryScale
verdict_line: World-class protein-AI science on a commoditizing model layer with no owned asset, payment rail, or data-attach moat; standalone company effectively ended ~18mo post-seed in a CZI acqui-hire.

name: OpenAI (life sciences)
verdict_line: Durable general-infrastructure toll (L9x, ~5-10yr) wearing a biology skin — but a demo, not a moat, in drug discovery; bio value accrues to the API toll and partner equity, not an owned asset.

name: Anthropic — Claude for Life Sciences
verdict_line: Durable compute toll at the parent level wearing a life-sciences costume — good business, but healthcare-AI expectation priced onto a frontier-model multiple.

name: Latent Labs
verdict_line: Credible AlphaFold-alumni team and a real lab-validated benchmark, but sitting on the L9b model-IP layer Ch5 dates at ~12 months; picks-and-shovels positioning is right, monetisation unproven, durable moat unbuilt — watch, don't own.

name: Abridge
verdict_line: Conditional durable value-capturer (B-): ~30%-share ambient-scribe leader, capital-light but a feature-not-franchise until the coding/CDI/RCM + licensed-CDS up-stack converts to owned workflow that survives Epic envelopment at price; rich ~50x-ARR pre-envelopment venture mark.

name: Ambience Healthcare
verdict_line: Conditional value-capturer: scribe leg is a rented slot, coding/CDI attach is the durable-shaped survivor — real but unproven at price and under-capitalized vs Epic and Abridge, at a rich ~40x mark. Grade C+, medium confidence.

name: Suki
verdict_line: Credible ambient-scribe with the right platform bet, but a feature sandwiched between a commoditizing LLM and the EHRs — no durable moat banked at a ~$0.4–0.5bn mark.

name: Commure (+Athelas)
verdict_line: Conditional value-capturer: L8 claims-to-cash rail is a durable moat candidate, L6 scribe already enveloped by Epic — insider-marked, subsidy-flattered roll-up at a full expectation. C+ / speculative.

name: Cohere Health
verdict_line: Conditional durable L8 utilization-management rail on the right side of the moat map, but pricing power is asserted (ARR growth) not proven (NRR-at-price); grade B / B-, full expectation.

name: Anterior
verdict_line: Durable value-capturer, EMERGING — right side of the workflow-ownership moat, but retention-at-price is unproven for a private at this stage.

name: OpenEvidence
verdict_line: Conditional durable value-capturer (B/B-plus): real revenue and 40%-physician distribution with a licensed-corpus + habit moat that clears the scarce-input bar, but the input is rented and the model commoditizes, so at ~80x run-rate the ~$12bn mark already prices near-perfect execution.

name: Hippocratic AI
verdict_line: Category-leading patient-facing voice AI whose only durable moat candidate — the accumulated safety record — is real but unproven on retention-at-price, at a full $3.5bn mark on no disclosed revenue.

name: Aidoc
verdict_line: Conditional value-capturer, demo-until-proven (C+/B-): real distribution and breadth, but the moat lives entirely in whether aiOS becomes owned orchestration vs a commoditizing model on rented rails.

name: Viz.ai
verdict_line: Durable value-capturer, narrowly — grade B/conditional-yes: owns an embedded multi-disease coordination workflow plus a life-sciences data-attach, but the algorithm commoditizes and the NTAP is transitional, not a permanent code.

name: Epic Systems
verdict_line: Durable decade-plus platform moat — the EHR system-of-record every L6 scribe rents from — but structurally un-investable: no equity, no external capital, private by design.

name: Ever Fortune AI
verdict_line: Best listed TW healthcare-AI pure-play — real loss-to-profit turn, broadest SaMD licence book — but small, ~12% GM, no NHI code, no investable moat, priced ~17x sales on a milestone-gated tech-transfer.

name: aetherAI (雲象科技)
verdict_line: Differentiated TW pathology-workflow pure-play with a thin-but-real installed-base moat that routes around the NHI chokepoint, but a loss-making micro-cap whose equity case rests on an unproven US/EU export push against global incumbents.

name: Acer Medical
verdict_line: Genuine first-mover imaging-triage SaMD with a strong parent, stranded one value-chain layer short of the payment dollar; real-but-not-investable moat and a domestic thesis gated on an NHI reimbursement vote that has not fired, at a rich brand-and-optionality expectation.

name: Amcad Biomed
verdict_line: World-first ultrasound-CAD franchise but a shrinking NT$30m-revenue micro-cap with no company-captured moat — a positioning marker gated on one binary NHI vote, not an investable long.

name: EBM Technologies
verdict_line: Watch-only: a sticky but mature, ex-growth domestic PACS incumbent whose imaging-AI aggregation-rail re-rate is plausible but unproven, undisclosed, and contested — a conditionally good business at a full expectation.

name: Health2Sync
verdict_line: Real, differentiated TW chronic-disease DTx/data-platform with genuine ~69% software margins and a growing Japan-export line, but pre-profit, richly/softly priced on 興櫃 (~140-170x sales), hinging on a single unproven 2026 NHI vote; the 1.6M-user data moat is a scale story, not a defensibility story — pharma/Japan-enterprise relationships are the only sticky leg.

name: ASUS AICS
verdict_line: Genuine L7-L8 coding/HIS node with a >NT$10bn parent-funded push, but zero standalone economics inside a NT$180bn/quarter PC-server parent, a state-captured (not company-captured) data moat, and a dead export proof point — not underwriteable as a healthcare-AI position.

name: Quanta QOCA
verdict_line: Largest-coverage TW medical cloud, but undisclosed, immaterial, and founder-declared non-commercial inside a NT$2.1tn AI-server ODM — a positioning marker, not an investable healthcare-AI pure-play.

name: Wistron Medical
verdict_line: Real dialysis-AI business but structurally uncapturable by an equity holder — unlisted, undisclosed, NHI-gated; only vehicle (3231) is an AI-server bet, not a healthcare-AI one.

name: Foxconn Health / CoDoctor (鴻海醫療, 2317 TT)
verdict_line: Positioning marker, not an investable healthcare-AI pure-play: real deployments (7 medical centres, TFDA-cleared devices, ~US$1.5bn "Healthy Taiwan" integrator role) but zero disclosed health economics, no standing NHI payment, and a moat that belongs to the ~NT$3.4tn ICT parent, not the health unit.

name: Taiwan hospital AI centres
verdict_line: Structural node, not a security — a real, deep, two-sided moat that is state-captured and stranded on non-listed balance sheets; use as the lens for pricing vendors selling INTO it, never as an exposure.
